name: stationary bike run v. 4
description: A stationary bike session at a brisk pace, similar to running in effort, to build heart and leg endurance.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.
